scope: Static disassembly and Ghidra evidence, not a callable recovered implementation.
descriptor: Constructor 0x141d2c800 initializes BuildingFoundation descriptor 0x1478c3b60. Instructions 0x141d2cc05-0x141d2cc43 put 0x141d394f0 into the callable at +0x10; 0x141d2cc82-0x141d2ccd1 put 0x141d398d0 into the callable at +0x90. It places 0x141d39420 in the +0xd0 callable and sets byte +8 to 2. Registration helper 0x141d59c70 copies only +0x90 and +0xd0 into slot 0x268; +0x10 is separate.
prepare: 0x141d394f0 only runs its body when global 0x148126190 is positive and [argument+0x1d0] is nonzero. It filters pointers in [argument+0x1c8] for first byte == 3, clears and rebuilds the array held by 0x1478c3c70, and appends one 0x60-byte entry for each filtered input. The calculation uses input vector data, several globals at 0x1478c36b4-0x1478c36d0 and powf. Input type, global meaning, update scheduling and complete floating-point semantics are not established.
significance: 0x141d398d0 returns 2.0 if the shared streaming switch is off or stream-in distance is nonpositive. Otherwise, if global 0x148126190 is positive, it searches the shared 0x60-stride array for a viewpoint-transform match, including either quaternion sign within 0.0001; a match uses its computed fields in a distinct distance calculation. If no match exists or the global is nonpositive, 0x141d39910 is used. That helper computes squared distance from a point derived from viewpoint translation to record bounds +0xb0 through +0xc4, combines it with squared stream-in and stream-out thresholds, and uses manager byte [record+0xd0]+0x15a to cap results >= 2.0 at approximately 1.9998 when the byte is clear. Altitude selection uses globals 0x1478c36c0/c4 and global 0x148126190. See probe4/0x141d398d0.c, probe4/0x141d39910.c and disassembly 0x141d398d0-0x141d39daa. Call ABI and local engine significance interface support record and FTransform arguments; exact record/global identities need confirmation.
post_significance: 0x141d39420 receives record, old and new significance, and a final flag, consistent with local UE USignificanceManager callback invocations. If the switch is off and old < 2, it invokes stream-in. Otherwise, when new >= 2, it invokes stream-in on crossing from old < 2, and can change the streaming object's priority to trunc(new*1000) when it differs from current priority by more than 100 and the loaded level is absent or its +0x1f4 mask 0x20 is clear. 0x1442e5840 reads/writes streaming object +0xb4 and updates its world on a state condition, matching local ULevelStreaming::SetPriority in structure. When new < 2, old > 0 and (final is true or new <= 0), it invokes unload. Exact float edge behavior follows the original COMISS instructions. Effects of stream-in/unload remain unresolved.
blocker: No complete faithful standalone callback can be integrated until the specialized manager record, descriptor initialization and ownership, per-view update path, shared global configuration, and stream-in/unload behavior are recovered. A guessed distance-only implementation would omit the prepared-viewpoint path and post-significance effects.
